# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.6

This patch corrects official release discovery in Project Control 2.0 on
Windows PowerShell.

## Fixed

- Option 8 now finds published GitHub releases and their server ZIP/checksums.
- Option 15 can again download the newest official release automatically when
  the ZIP path is left blank.
- Draft releases remain excluded.

## Existing 4.0.0-next.5 installations

Download and extract this release, then run `INSTALL-PROJECT-CONTROL.bat` once
to repair the controller before using option 15. Alternatively, option 15 in
the existing controller can install this release when given the full path to
the downloaded `server-update-4.0.0-next.6.zip`.

There is no database migration or application-feature change. Production
`.env`, the database, RX Softphone, and frozen 3.3.1 are unchanged.
